segments.normalizedSource: ```swift // Applies visual emphasis to the year component of a formatted attributed date string. private func makeAttributedString() -> AttributedString { let date = Date() let formatStyle = Date.FormatStyle(date: .abbreviated, time: .standard) var attributedString = formatStyle.attributed.format(date) for run in attributedString.runs { if let dateFieldAttribute = run.attributes.foundation.dateField, dateFieldAttribute == .year { // When you find a year, change its attributes. attributedString[run.range].inlinePresentationIntent = [.emphasized, .stronglyEmphasized] } } return attributedString } ```
